mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Force Pulse (@Stack@)</titleLeft><mainText>After 6 spells are cast near Kassadin, he can cast Force Pulse.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Kassadin draws energy from spells cast in his vicinity. Upon charging up, Kassadin can use Force Pulse to damage and slow enemies in a cone in front of him.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Passive: {{Spell_ForcePulse_Name}}'s Cooldown is reduced by @ReductionPerSpellCast@ second whenever any Ability is used near Kassadin.

Active: Kassadin unleashes a void pulse, dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage and Slowing by @SlowAmount@% for @SlowDuration@ second.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Force Pulse Available</titleLeft><mainText>Kassadin can cast Force Pulse.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Nether Blade</titleLeft><mainText>Kassadin's basic attacks deal bonus magic damage.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Passive: Kassadin's basic attacks deal bonus magic damage. Active: Kassadin's next basic attack deals significant bonus magic damage and restores Mana.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Passive: Kassadin's Attacks deal an additional @OnHitDamage@ magic damage.

Active: Kassadin charges his blade, causing his next Attack to deal @ActiveDamage@ magic damage and restore @MissingManaRatio@% missing Mana, increased to @ChampionMissingManaRatio@% against champions.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Charged Nether Blade</titleLeft><mainText>Kassadin's next basic attack deals bonus magic damage and restores Mana.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Null Sphere</titleLeft><mainText>This unit has a shield that absorbs magic damage.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Kassadin fires an orb of void energy at a target, dealing damage and interrupting channels. The excess energy forms around himself, granting a temporary shield that absorbs magic damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Kassadin fires an orb of void energy, dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> and interrupting channels. Kassadin also gains <shield>@TotalShield@ Magic Shield</shield> for 1.5 seconds.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Riftwalk (@Stack@)</titleLeft><mainText>Kassadin's next Riftwalk has an increased Mana cost but deals additional damage.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Kassadin teleports to a nearby location dealing damage to nearby enemy units. Multiple Riftwalks in a short period of time cost additional Mana but also deal additional damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Kassadin teleports to a nearby location, dealing @BaseDamage@ magic damage.

Each subsequent use of this Ability within the next @RStackDuration@ seconds doubles the Mana cost and deals an additional @BonusDamage@ magic damage. The cost and damage increases can stack up to @MaxStacks@ times.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Kassadin takes reduced magic damage and ignores unit collision.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Kassadin takes @DamageReductionPercent*100@% reduced magic damage and is Ghosted.
